units.source_text: 薰君为了自己遭大女公子如此冷遇和拒绝，深觉可耻，便不再热烈追求，只是认真地商谈匂亲王和二女公子之事。

en.t: Kaoru felt deeply ashamed that the elder princess had treated and rejected him so coldly, so he no longer pursued her ardently, but only spoke earnestly about Prince Niou and the second princess.

units.source_text: 对大女公子说：“匂亲王的本性，在恋爱方面是稍稍热心过度的，所以即使不是十分深爱渴慕的事，一经启口，便不肯收回成命。

en.t: He said to the elder princess, "Prince Niou's nature is somewhat overly ardent in matters of love, and so even when something is not a matter of very deep passion or longing, once he has spoken of it, he will not take back his command.

units.source_text: 恐是因此之故，所以多方设法探询尊意。

en.t: I suspect that is why he has tried in every possible way to learn your wishes.

units.source_text: 这件亲事其实是很可放心答应的，为什么如此坚决拒绝呢？

en.t: This marriage proposal is in fact one you may safely accept, so why do you reject it so firmly?

units.source_text: 人世男婚女嫁之事，您不是全然不理解的，但一直拒人于千里之外，辜负我这一片无私的忠诚，叫我好恨啊！

en.t: You cannot be entirely unaware of the ways of men and women in marriage, yet you keep everyone at a great distance and betray my wholly selfless loyalty; it makes me bitter indeed!

units.source_text: 今天无论如何，要请您把尊见明白告我。”

en.t: Today, whatever happens, I must ask you to tell me your thoughts plainly."

units.source_text: 大女公子答道：“正为了不敢辜负您的忠诚，所以我不惜抛头露面，开诚相待。

en.t: The elder princess answered, "Precisely because I dare not betray your loyalty, I have not hesitated to show myself and have met you with an open heart.

units.source_text: 您倘不理解我这点心情，恐怕您心中怀着浅薄的想法吧。

en.t: If you do not understand this feeling of mine, then I fear you must be harboring shallow thoughts in your heart.

units.source_text: 当然，倘是善解情趣之人，则处此荒寂之境，自有无穷感想。

en.t: Of course, someone who truly understands refinement and feeling would find endless thoughts even in this desolate and lonely place.

units.source_text: 但我生性愚陋，只是茫然度日。

en.t: But I am dull by nature, and merely pass my days in a daze.

units.source_text: 先父在世之时，关于我等将来虽然曾有遗嘱：某事应该如何，某事应该如何，但是关于您所说的婚姻之事，全然不曾谈及。

en.t: When my late father was alive, he did leave instructions about our future, saying how this matter should be handled and how that matter should be handled, but he never spoke at all of the marriage you mention.

units.source_text: 可知先父之意，确是教我们断绝结婚之念，如此度送一生。

en.t: From this I understand that my father's true intention was to have us give up all thought of marriage and pass our lives in this way.

units.source_text: 因此对于您的垂询，我实无法答复。

en.t: For that reason, I truly cannot answer your gracious inquiry.

units.source_text: 不过舍妹年纪还轻，隐没在这深山之中，实甚可惜，故我亦曾私下计虑，但愿她不要就此变成朽木。

en.t: However, my younger sister is still young, and it would be a great pity for her to remain buried here in these deep mountains, so I too have privately considered things and wished that she would not simply become dead wood here.
Only, I do not know what fate will bring."

units.source_text: 说罢长叹一声，茫然耽入沉思，那模样甚是可怜。

en.t: After saying this, she gave a long sigh and sank blankly into deep thought; her appearance was very pitiable.
